blurb:
Board your private airplane at Miami Executive Airport and take off over South Miami on a scenic flight to the Florida Keys and back. You’ll glide over Biscayne National Park, spotting the protected islands of Elliott Key and Old Rhodes Key, framed by turquoise shallows, mangrove coastlines, and winding creeks.

Continue south to Key Largo, the first and largest of the Florida Key, where the bright blue coastline and surrounding natural preserves create some of the most stunning views in Florida. After enjoying the Keys from above, you’ll turn back toward Miami, completing a round-trip flight filled with unforgettable ocean and island scenery.
